classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_wind.desc: Your horse spends its stamina 15% slower under you, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_whisper.des: Your horse never shies or throws you, bucks no more, and a timid one is braver under you.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_lancer.desc: A lance or spear at the gallop gains half again as much from the pace, and the mounted charge builds twice as fast.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_archer.desc: Arrows and bolts loosed from the saddle fly straight where you look, without stray from the shot or the horse's sway.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_stay.desc: Blows and blasts no longer knock you off: a startled horse keeps you on, and a blow that tears you from the saddle finds you back on it at once.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_trick.desc: The class key off the gallop swings you down the horse's side, and back up. Hanging there, arrows meet the horse (at half) instead of you, and at the gallop you scoop up what lies on the ground, or a downed friend up behind you.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_cavalier.de: Barding weighs nothing on your horse, charges and an elephant's trampling hit half again as hard, and your horse learns war twice as fast.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_outrider.de: Faster at the trot and canter, your horse takes no harm from falls, and the whistle in the saddle brings your freshest horse alongside to be swapped onto on the move.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_herd.desc: An order from the command wheel goes to all your horses about at once, and they come to your aid whatever their trust.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_banner.desc: With a banner on your horse's tack, friends near you shake off fear and hit 10% harder, and the horses they ride gallop a quarter longer.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_bonded.desc: Your horse, once down, stays down instead of dying, to be brought round.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_legend.desc: A nightmare, a bat horse or a war elephant trusts you fully the moment you sit it (a wild one is yours), and a bat horse tires half as fast aloft.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rider.spur_saddle: You need to be in the saddle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rider.spur_wait: Your horse is ready for the spur in %s s.
